notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a photograph attributed to Katherine Maria Routledge, dated circa 1919. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact. The museum's image page identifies this documentary representation, states image-specific CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms and supplies the required credit. The original JPEG was downloaded, visually reviewed against the catalogue description and preserved unchanged. The complete Description and the photograph's inscription identify an in-situ bird-man carving at Orongo; the record does not identify the individual carving as a separate MoSA object.
